notes: Fuel yields were cut to about a healing-herb gathering's value (designer call 2026-11-13: fuel's base price rose to 5 gp, which made firewood the best option almost everywhere), and firewood is gathered only in forest. What one member can gather in a settlement's domain over GATHER_DAYS (2) days (Plan 5a, design §10b; designer call 2026-11-13): one rule per good and kind of land. The best-suited member rolls the skill against the DC, lowered by 1 per output level where the domain makes the good (GATHER_DC_PER_OUTPUT), and works alone on their own rations while the rest of the party waits: `yield` is the units per tier for the whole gathering, lowered as the land is picked over (GATHER_DEPTH_DAYS). The yields were doubled from the old one-day, two-worker ones (2026-11-13), so a gathering is worth what the old day's work for two was per day: the choice is about time, not a nerf. Yields were set (I1 economy report) so a fresh day for two sold for about 4–6 gp in the domain, before depletion and bulk pressure: food sells at the 1 gp floor, healing herbs are the hardest, and timber and stone fetch less (about 1 gp a day): they are heavy (20–25 kg a unit, capped by what the party can carry) and cheap, and a small market sags under a few units. Fuel's base price rose from 0.3 to 5 gp (designer, 2026-11-13), so fuel gathering is now worth about 3.3× the median rule a day (15–17 gp); its yields are unchanged pending the designer's call. A partial success always brings home at least 1 unit (a content test checks this). Every land biome has at least one rule (a content test checks this). Written by Claude; tuned by the I1 economy report.

entries.label: Cut timber
entries.text: Fell and trim what the woodsmen left standing, and drag it to the road.

entries.label: Quarry stone
entries.text: Break good stone out of an old cutting and lever it onto a sledge.

entries.label: Gather firewood
entries.text: Deadfall, windblown branches and the odd stump, bundled for the town's hearths.

entries.label: Cut peat
entries.text: Slice turves from the bog and stack them to drain.

entries.label: Gather scrub and dung
entries.text: Thornwood roots and dried dung: what burns where nothing grows.

entries.label: Hunt and snare game
entries.text: Set snares at dawn, stalk at dusk, and smoke what you catch.

entries.label: Fish and forage
entries.text: Weirs in the shallows, roots and fruit along the banks.

entries.label: Gather healing herbs
entries.text: Woundwort, feverfew and moss, found by those who know the leaf, and dried for kits.
